verdict.rationale: Attio's AI platform docs describe in-product AI features like buying-signal detection, call transcription and analysis, account briefs, AI-driven workflow agents (scoring, routing, web research), and 'search, update, create with AI' surfaced directly in the CRM, which match the story of AI-generated insights/suggestions from workspace data. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of these AI insight features in real use (all evidence is vendor marketing copy) and detail on underlying model/accuracy.
